capabilities: Write handwriting in fixed-size, paginated notebooks with pen, highlighter and shape tools
Recognize handwriting on-device with the Grape model for search, titles and links
Annotate imported PDFs and insert pictures, scans and text boxes
Record audio and replay it from any written word
Export notebooks or selected pages as PDF
disambiguation: Handwriting lives in separate .notebook.md files and cannot be embedded in other notes; only links can point to notebooks and pages.
extras: Free with optional GitHub Sponsors donations. The Grape model (3.5 MB) is downloaded once from GitHub; AI features are optional and need the user's own API key. Warns not to run InkedMark in the same vault, as both open .ink.md files.
intentEvidence: The purpose of this plugin is to be a complete alternative to those note-taking apps.
motivation: The author was tired of paid note-taking apps (Goodnotes, Notability), Apple Notes' poor performance, companies holding notes in their cloud, and sync problems between Windows and Apple devices.
problem: Obsidian has no handwriting support, and dedicated note-taking apps like Goodnotes store notes in paid, cloud-locked formats that do not sync well across platforms.

summary: Paginated handwriting notebooks for any stylus, with on-device handwriting recognition, PDF annotation, audio recording and PDF export, stored as plain vault files.
